version "4.10"

// ==========================================================================================================
// ULTRA BADASS QUESTSABER -- GENERATED by RS_VR_Weapons/_pending/tools/ubqs.py from ubqs_zscript.txt.
// A standalone lightsaber for stock QuestZDoom 17.x. Load it AFTER Xim's or Wardust's weapons (or on plain
// Doom): it replaces their saber, on the map and in your hands. Everything here is playsim, so netplay sees
// the same saber, the same cuts and the same deflections on every machine; colour, size and the alt fire are
// your own (userinfo), what it does to the game is the server's.
// ==========================================================================================================

// ---- THE TABLES ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The md3's frames: A-C idle shimmer, D-I overhead chop, J-M side cut, N-Q ignition, R unlit in the hand,
// S nothing in the hand (thrown), T flat and lit (in the air), U flat and unlit (lying on the floor).
// Pose = the blade raised `up` from the aim, swung `yaw` left.
class UBQS_Data
{
	const NCOL = %(ncol)d;
	// THE TWIRL'S FRAMES come after the saber's own (md3 frames TW0..TW0+TWN-1): the staff upright, turned
	// about the hand's forward axis -- drawn under their own sprite (V<size><col>X).
	const TW0 = %(tw0)d;
	const TWN = %(twn)d;
	static bool IsTwirl(int f) { return f >= TW0; }
	static double TwAngle(int f) { return IsTwirl(f) ? (f - TW0) * 360.0 / TWN : 0.0; }
	static double Yaw(int f) { if (IsTwirl(f)) return 0; static const double T[] = { %(yaw)s }; return T[clamp(f, 0, %(nf)d)]; }
	static double Up(int f)  { if (IsTwirl(f)) return 90; static const double T[] = { %(up)s }; return T[clamp(f, 0, %(nf)d)]; }
	static double Ext(int f) { if (IsTwirl(f)) return 1; static const double T[] = { %(ext)s }; return T[clamp(f, 0, %(nf)d)]; }
	static String Col(int c) { String t = "%(colstr)s"; return t.Mid(clamp(c, 0, NCOL - 1), 1); }
	static int Rgb(int c)    { static const int T[] = { %(rgb)s }; return T[clamp(c, 0, NCOL - 1)]; }
	static double Size(int s) { static const double T[] = { %(sizes)s }; return T[clamp(s, 0, 4)]; }

	// A SETTING: the player's own (userinfo) when there is a player to ask, else the server's.
	static double F(Actor who, String n, double fb)
	{
		CVar c = null;
		if (who && who.player) c = CVar.GetCVar(n, who.player);
		if (!c) c = CVar.FindCVar(n);
		return c ? c.GetFloat() : fb;
	}
	static int I(Actor who, String n, int fb)
	{
		CVar c = null;
		if (who && who.player) c = CVar.GetCVar(n, who.player);
		if (!c) c = CVar.FindCVar(n);
		return c ? c.GetInt() : fb;
	}

	// THE SEGMENTS' CLOSEST APPROACH (Ericson 5.1.9): segment a0..a0+da against the origin..db
	static double SegSeg(Vector3 a0, Vector3 da, Vector3 db)
	{
		return SegVec(a0, da, db).Length();
	}
	// the vector from the nearest point on segment B to the nearest point on segment A
	static Vector3 SegVec(Vector3 a0, Vector3 da, Vector3 db)
	{
		double s, t;
		return SegST(a0, da, db, s, t);
	}
	// ...and how far along each segment those nearest points are (0 = its start, 1 = its end)
	static Vector3 SegST(Vector3 a0, Vector3 da, Vector3 db, out double s, out double t)
	{
		double a = da dot da, e = db dot db, f = db dot a0;
		s = 0;
		t = 0;
		if (a <= 0.000001 && e <= 0.000001) return a0;
		if (a <= 0.000001) t = clamp(f / e, 0.0, 1.0);
		else
		{
			double c = da dot a0;
			if (e <= 0.000001) s = clamp(-c / a, 0.0, 1.0);
			else
			{
				double b = da dot db, den = a * e - b * b;
				s = (den != 0) ? clamp((b * f - c * e) / den, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
				t = (b * s + f) / e;
				if (t < 0) { t = 0; s = clamp(-c / a, 0.0, 1.0); }
				else if (t > 1) { t = 1; s = clamp((b - c) / a, 0.0, 1.0); }
			}
		}
		return a0 + da * s - db * t;
	}

	// SPARKS: the owner's CombatFX spark burst (UXSP), a hot star on a big one (UXST), and a flash in the
	// blade's colour (UXHF). Sprites, never engine particles (the owner, 10-01).
	static play void Sparks(Vector3 at, Vector3 dir, int rgb, int n)
	{
		double sc = clamp(0.035 + n * 0.004, 0.04, 0.11);
		UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXSP', 7, 2, sc, 1.0);
		if (n >= 8) UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXST', 1, 6, sc * 0.9, 0.9, -1, 0.92);
		if (rgb != 0xFFFFFF && rgb != 0xFFF4D8) UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXHF', 10, 1, sc * 1.2, 0.75, Mix(rgb, 0xFFFFFF, 0.35));
	}
	static int Mix(int a, int b, double t)
	{
		int r = int(((a >> 16) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((b >> 16) & 255) * t);
		int g = int(((a >> 8) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((b >> 8) & 255) * t);
		int bl = int((a & 255) * (1 - t) + (b & 255) * t);
		return (clamp(r, 0, 255) << 16) | (clamp(g, 0, 255) << 8) | clamp(bl, 0, 255);
	}
	// A GLOW: one soft blob in a colour (UXGL), for trails and bolts
	static play void Glow(Vector3 at, int rgb, double sc, double a, int life)
	{
		UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXGL', 1, life, sc, a, rgb, 0.9);
	}
}

// ---- A LIGHT ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ONE ACTOR, ONE ATTACHED LIGHT, set by script: any colour, any radius, no GLDEFS table. It is moved with
// SetOrigin(..., true), so the renderer slides it between tics with the blade. The light is re-attached only
// when its colour or (quantised) radius changes -- never per tic.
class UBQS_Light : Actor
{
	int litRgb;
	int litRad;

	Default
	{
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+NOGRAVITY
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+NOTELEPORT
		Radius 1;
		Height 1;
	}
	void Look(int rgb, double rad)
	{
		int r = int(rad / 4.0) * 4;
		if (rgb == litRgb && r == litRad) return;
		litRgb = rgb;
		litRad = r;
		A_RemoveLight('UBQS');
		if (r > 0) A_AttachLight('UBQS', DynamicLight.PointLight, rgb, r, 0, DynamicLight.LF_ATTENUATE);
	}
	void Dark() { Look(0, 0); }
	States { Spawn: UBQL A -1; Stop; }
}

// ---- A RETURNED SHOT -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A blocked hitscan shot, sent back at whoever fired it: a streak of the blade's colour. No light, no model:
// a fullbright particle trail, which costs next to nothing.
class UBQS_Bolt : FastProjectile
{
	int rgb;
	Default
	{
		Radius 3;
		Height 4;
		Speed 60;
		DamageFunction (UBQS_Data.I(target, "ubqs_block_damage", 20));
		DamageType "Saber";
		+NOEXTREMEDEATH
		+DONTSPLASH
		SeeSound "";
		DeathSound "ubqs/wall";
		Obituary "%%o caught %%k's deflected shot.";
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Vector3 from = pos;
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		// THE BOLT: a hot core where it is and a trail of its colour behind -- CombatFX glows, a few a tic
		Vector3 step = level.Vec3Diff(from, pos);
		int n = clamp(int(step.Length() / 14.0), 1, 4);
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) UBQS_Data.Glow(from + step * ((i + 0.5) / n), rgb, 0.075, 0.7, 5);
		UBQS_Data.Glow(pos, UBQS_Data.Mix(rgb, 0xFFFFFF, 0.6), 0.045, 1.0, 2);
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		TNT1 A -1;
		Stop;
	Death:
		TNT1 A 1 { UBQS_Data.Sparks(pos, (0, 0, 1), invoker.rgb, 6); }
		Stop;
	}
}

// ---- THE CUTTING EDGE: what a line tracer sees ------------------------------------------------------------
class UBQS_Tracer : LineTracer
{
	override ETraceStatus TraceCallback()
	{
		if (Results.HitType == TRACE_HitActor) return TRACE_Skip;
		if (Results.HitType == TRACE_HitWall && Results.Tier == TIER_Middle && Results.HitLine
			&& (Results.HitLine.flags & Line.ML_TWOSIDED)) return TRACE_Skip;
		return TRACE_Stop;
	}
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE SABER
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_SaberBase : Weapon abstract
{
	int  frameNow;            // the frame on screen (UBQS_Data), which decides the pose and whether it is lit
	bool back;                // the second blade, out of the pommel
	int  slashNo;             // alternates the two slashes
	int  altHold;             // tics the second button has been held (alt = tap: blade / hold: throw)
	UBQS_Thrown thrown;       // out of the hand (in the air, or lying somewhere); null in the hand
	int  lastFastTic;         // the last tic the blade was swung hard (a swung blade blocks surely)
	int  clashQuiet, burnQuiet, swingQuiet, flashTics;
	bool humming;
	private Vector3 lastTip, lastBase;
	private bool    lastOk;
	private Array<Actor> cutWho;
	private Array<int>   cutWhen;
	private Array<UBQS_Light> glow;   // the blade's own lights (1-3, ubqs_lights)
	private UBQS_Light flash;         // hits, blocks, clashes, burns: one light, reused

	Default
	{
		Weapon.SlotNumber 1;
		Weapon.SelectionOrder 2100;
		Weapon.Kickback 0;
		Weapon.BobStyle "Smooth";
		+WEAPON.MELEEWEAPON
		+WEAPON.NOALERT
		+WEAPON.AMMO_OPTIONAL
		+WEAPON.NOAUTOAIM
		+WEAPON.NOAUTOFIRE
		Inventory.PickupMessage "You got a lightsaber!";
		Inventory.PickupSound "ubqs/catch";
		Tag "Lightsaber";
		Obituary "%%o was cut down by %%k's lightsaber.";
	}

	// ---- settings --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	double UF(String n, double fb) { return UBQS_Data.F(owner, n, fb); }
	int    UInt(String n, int fb)  { return UBQS_Data.I(owner, n, fb); }
	int SizeIdx()
	{
		double s = UF("ubqs_size", 1.0);
		int best = 2;
		double d = 99;
		for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
		{
			double dd = abs(UBQS_Data.Size(i) - s);
			if (dd < d) { d = dd; best = i; }
		}
		return best;
	}
	int ColIdx() { return clamp(UInt(bOffhandWeapon ? "ubqs_color_off" : "ubqs_color", 0), 0, UBQS_Data.NCOL - 1); }
	int RgbNow() { return UBQS_Data.Rgb(ColIdx()); }
	String SpriteNow() { return String.Format("S%%d%%s%%s", SizeIdx() + 1, UBQS_Data.Col(ColIdx()), back ? "D" : "S"); }

	// ---- what the psprite shows: this saber's size / colour / blades, at frame f -------------------------
	action void A_UBShow(int f)
	{
		if (invoker.thrown || invoker.merged) f = %(fr_s)d;   // S: out of the hand (or in the staff), nothing drawn
		else if (invoker.igniteAnim > 0) f = invoker.IgniteFrame();
		else if (invoker.doused && !UBQS_Data.IsTwirl(f)) f = %(fr_r)d;   // R: the hilt, blade off
		invoker.frameNow = f;
		let psp = player.FindPSprite(invoker.bOffhandWeapon ? PSP_OFFHANDWEAPON : PSP_WEAPON);
		if (!psp) return;
		if (UBQS_Data.IsTwirl(f))
		{
			psp.Sprite = GetSpriteIndex(String.Format("V%%d%%sX", invoker.SizeIdx() + 1, UBQS_Data.Col(invoker.ColIdx())));
			psp.Frame = f - UBQS_Data.TW0;
			return;
		}
		psp.Sprite = GetSpriteIndex(invoker.SpriteNow());
		psp.Frame = f;
		// (no blade glow layer: the owner, 10-01 -- "go back to the OG sabers, just the models")
	}
	// THE GLOW, IN THE HAND: a second layer of this saber, drawn ADDITIVE, its model the glow shell baked onto
	// the blade for every frame (ubqs.py glow_md3) -- drawn with the blade, from the controller, every frame,
	// so it cannot lag (the owner, 10-01). ubqs_blade_glow is its strength (0 off); ubqs_blade_glow_color its
	// colour (-1 the blade's own).
	action void A_UBGlow(int f)
	{
		// drawn AFTER both sabers (layers are drawn in order; the off hand's saber is layer 1000000), so a glow
		// can never black out a blade drawn after it (the owner, 10-01)
		int gl = invoker.bOffhandWeapon ? 2000052 : 2000051;
		double str = invoker.UF("ubqs_blade_glow", 0.6);
		if (!player.FindPSprite(gl))
		{
			if (str <= 0.01) return;
			A_Overlay(gl, "GlowHold");
			A_OverlayFlags(gl, PSPF_RENDERSTYLE | PSPF_ALPHA | PSPF_FORCEALPHA, true);
			A_OverlayRenderStyle(gl, STYLE_Add);
		}
		let g = player.FindPSprite(gl);
		if (!g) return;
		bool show = str > 0.01 && !UBQS_Data.IsTwirl(f) && f != %(fr_s)d && f != %(fr_r)d;
		int ci = invoker.UInt("ubqs_blade_glow_color", -1);
		int col = (ci < 0) ? invoker.ColIdx() : clamp(ci, 0, UBQS_Data.NCOL - 1);
		g.Sprite = GetSpriteIndex(String.Format("G%%d%%s%%s", invoker.SizeIdx() + 1, UBQS_Data.Col(col), invoker.back ? "D" : "S"));
		g.Frame = show ? f : %(fr_s)d;
		g.Alpha = clamp(str, 0.0, 1.0);
	}
	// IDLE: the shimmer -- or, with the second blade lit, the staff twirling in your hand (ubqs_twirl)
	action void A_UBReady(int f)
	{
		if (invoker.igniteAnim > 0) invoker.igniteAnim--;
		if (invoker.Twirling())
		{
			int step = (invoker.UInt("ubqs_twirl", 2) >= 2) ? 1 : 2;
			f = UBQS_Data.TW0 + (level.maptime / step) %% UBQS_Data.TWN;
		}
		A_UBShow(f);
		A_WeaponReady();
	}
	// THE IGNITION IS HEARD WHEN YOU DRAW THE SABER, AND ONLY THEN (the owner, 10-01): once per draw, and
	// the shut-off once per putting away -- not on a throw, a catch, a recall, or the engine re-raising it.
	bool ignited;
	action void A_UBOn()
	{
		if (invoker.thrown || invoker.ignited) return;
		// ubqs_autoignite 0: it comes out dark -- a flick of the wrist lights it
		// (always lights when drawn: there is no wrist flick to light it any more)
		invoker.doused = false;
		invoker.ignited = true;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/on", CHAN_WEAPON);
	}
	action void A_UBOff()
	{
		if (invoker.thrown || !invoker.ignited) return;
		invoker.ignited = false;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/off", CHAN_WEAPON);
	}
	// ---- FIRE: LOCK ON, THEN THROW IT WITH YOUR ARM (the owner, 10-01) -------------------------------------
	// There is no button swing: the saber cuts what your real swing passes it through (DoEffect). Fire is the
	// throw. HOLD it and sweep your hand across enemies: each one in a narrow cone of your hand's line is locked
	// (up to ubqs_locks), marked with a gold diamond. THROW with your arm, fire still held, and it flies to each
	// in turn -- or, with none, along your swing. Let go with the hand moving, or after locking, and it is
	// thrown too; let go with the hand still and nothing locked, and nothing happens. It lights its second blade
	// as it leaves your hand. With the saber out of your hand, fire calls it back.
	action state A_UBHoldBegin()
	{
		invoker.altHold = 0;
		if (invoker.merged) return ResolveState("AltDone");
		if (invoker.thrown) { invoker.thrown.Recall(); return ResolveState("AltDone"); }
		// marks from a hold you let go of a moment ago are picked back up; older ones start fresh
		if (level.maptime > invoker.keepMarksUntil) invoker.ClearLocks();
		invoker.keepMarksUntil = 0;
		return null;
	}
	action state A_UBHold()
	{
		int bit = invoker.bOffhandWeapon ? BT_OFFHANDATTACK : BT_ATTACK;
		bool held = player && (player.cmd.buttons & bit);
		invoker.altHold++;
		double thr = invoker.UF("ubqs_throw_min", 1.5);
		// HOLDING FIRE NEVER THROWS (the owner, 10-01): mark, swing, walk, turn -- the saber stays in your hand.
		// THE THROW IS LETTING GO: release fire while the hand snaps FORWARD, out where you are looking. A slash,
		// a chop or a backhand released mid-swing is not a throw. A slow release keeps the marks for a second.
		if (!held)
		{
			if (invoker.ThrowRelease(thr)) invoker.Throw();
			else invoker.keepMarksUntil = level.maptime + 35;
			return ResolveState("AltDone");
		}
		invoker.Paint();
		return null;
	}

	// ---- ALT: THE FORCE PUSH (ubqs_alt 1) -------------------------------------------------------------------
	action state A_UBAltFire()
	{
		if (invoker.merged) return ResolveState("AltDone");
		if (invoker.thrown) { invoker.thrown.Recall(); return ResolveState("AltDone"); }
		// THE OFF HAND'S ALT IS THE FORCE BY GESTURE (UBQS_Force reads it): thrust, yank, or hold on an enemy
		if (invoker.bOffhandWeapon && invoker.UInt("ubqs_force_gestures", 1)) return ResolveState("AltDone");
		if (invoker.UInt("ubqs_alt", 1) == 0) { invoker.ToggleBack(); return ResolveState("AltDone"); }
		invoker.ForcePush();
		return ResolveState("AltDone");
	}
	// THE FORCE PUSH from the saber hand: the Force item (UBQS_Force) does it, so both hands share one cooldown
	void ForcePush()
	{
		if (!owner) return;
		let f = UBQS_Force.Of(owner);
		if (f) f.Push(HandPos(), Aim());
	}

	// ---- PAINTING: the enemy nearest your hand's line, inside a narrow cone, one every few tics ---------------
	Array<Actor> locks;
	int lastPaintTic;
	void Paint()
	{
		int most = clamp(UInt("ubqs_locks", 5), 1, 8);
		if (locks.Size() >= most || level.maptime - lastPaintTic < 3) return;
		lastPaintTic = level.maptime;
		Vector3 hp = HandPos();
		double ha = HA(), hpit = HP();
		Actor best = null;
		double bestOff = UF("ubqs_lock_cone", 14.0);
		double range = 1536.0;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z - range, range * 2.0, range, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || !mo.bIsMonster || !mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bFriendly) continue;
			if (locks.Find(mo) < locks.Size()) continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(hp, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			if (to.Length() > range) continue;
			double dAng = absangle(ha, VectorAngle(to.x, to.y));
			double tPit = -atan2(to.z, max(1.0, to.xy.Length()));
			double off = max(dAng, abs(DeltaAngle(hpit, tPit)));
			if (off >= bestOff) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			bestOff = off;
			best = mo;
		}
		if (!best) return;
		locks.Push(best);
		UBQS_LockMark.MarkFor(self, best);
		Buzz();
	}
	// Haptic tick on the saber hand. QZD has no script haptics; the engine buzzes the firing hand on any
	// player hitscan with damage > 0. A 1-unit trace pointed straight up reaches nothing: no puff, no hit, no noise.
	void Buzz()
	{
		if (!owner || !owner.player) return;
		owner.LineAttack(owner.angle, 1, -90, 1, 'UBQS_Haptic', 'UBQS_HapticPuff', bOffhandWeapon ? 256 : 0);
	}
	void ClearLocks()
	{
		locks.Clear();
		UBQS_LockMark.ClearAll(self);
	}
	void ToggleBack()
	{
		if (joined) return;
		back = !back;
		if (owner) owner.A_StartSound(back ? "ubqs/on" : "ubqs/off", CHAN_WEAPON);
	}

	// ---- THE HAND ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Vector3 HandPos()
	{
		Vector3 p = bOffhandWeapon ? owner.OffhandPos : owner.AttackPos;
		if (p == (0, 0, 0)) p = owner.Vec3Offset(0, 0, owner.player ? owner.player.viewheight * 0.8 : 40.0);
		return p;
	}
	double HA() { return (bOffhandWeapon ? owner.OffhandAngle : owner.AttackAngle) + 90.0; }
	double HP() { return -(bOffhandWeapon ? owner.OffhandPitch : owner.AttackPitch); }
	double HR() { return bOffhandWeapon ? owner.OffhandRoll : owner.AttackRoll; }
	int keepMarksUntil;
	// a forward throw: fast enough, and moving out the way you face (not across you, down, or back)
	bool ThrowRelease(double thr)
	{
		Vector3 hv = HandVel();
		double sp = hv.Length();
		if (sp < thr) return false;
		double p = owner.pitch, a = owner.angle;
		Vector3 fwd = (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
		return (hv / sp) dot fwd >= 0.55;
	}
	Vector3 Aim()
	{
		double a = HA(), p = HP();
		return (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
	}
	// THE BLADE'S DIRECTION for the frame on screen: the aim raised `up` about the wrist, swung `yaw` left
	Vector3 BladeDir()
	{
		// THE ROLL TURNS THE OTHER WAY (the owner in the headset, 10-01: the debug dots were the blade mirrored
		// left-right -- blade tilted to 11 o'clock, dots at 1). QuestZDoom draws the hand model rolled by
		// -AttackRoll, and the off hand mirrored in X, so the frame's own yaw and twirl flip with the hand.
		double m = bOffhandWeapon ? 1.0 : -1.0;
		double a = HA(), r = -HR() + m * UBQS_Data.TwAngle(frameNow);
		Vector3 f = Aim();
		Vector3 flatRight = (sin(a), -cos(a), 0);
		Vector3 levelUp = flatRight cross f;
		Vector3 upv = levelUp * cos(r) - flatRight * sin(r);
		Vector3 right = flatRight * cos(r) + levelUp * sin(r);
		double yw = m * UBQS_Data.Yaw(frameNow), u = UBQS_Data.Up(frameNow);
		return f * (cos(u) * cos(yw)) - right * (cos(u) * sin(yw)) + upv * sin(u);
	}
	double FullLen() { return %(blade_world).1f * UBQS_Data.Size(SizeIdx()); }
	double BladeLen() { return max(0.0, BeamAlong(%(tip_mx).3f, %(tip_mz).3f) - BeamAlong(%(emit_mx).3f, %(emit_mz).3f)) * max(UBQS_Data.Ext(frameNow), 0.0); }
	// THE BEAM STARTS AT THE EMITTER, NOT IN YOUR HAND (the owner, 10-01: "your dots still sit in the handle").
	// How far along the blade's line a point of the model is drawn from the controller: the HUD model's own
	// offsets (MODELDEF Offset, the engine's (0, 5, 30) cm), the model point (md3 x forward, z up in the
	// blade's plane) times its Scale and vr_weaponScale, along the blade drawn `up` above the hand's line.
	double BeamAlong(double mx, double mz)
	{
		let wsc = CVar.FindCVar("vr_weaponScale");
		let vuc = CVar.FindCVar("vr_vunits_per_meter");
		double k = %(hud_sc).4f * UBQS_Data.Size(SizeIdx()) * (wsc ? wsc.GetFloat() : 1.0);
		double vu = vuc ? vuc.GetFloat() : 34.0;
		double u = UBQS_Data.Up(0);
		return vu * 0.01 * ((5.0 + %(hud_oz).3f + k * mz) * sin(u) - (30.0 + %(hud_oy).3f - k * mx) * cos(u));
	}
	Vector3 BladeBase() { return HandPos() + BladeDir() * BeamAlong(%(emit_mx).3f, %(emit_mz).3f); }
	Vector3 Pommel()    { return HandPos() + BladeDir() * BeamAlong(-%(emit_mx).3f, -%(emit_mz).3f); }
	bool InHand()
	{
		if (!owner || !owner.player) return false;
		return bOffhandWeapon ? (owner.player.OffhandWeapon == self) : (owner.player.ReadyWeapon == self);
	}
	bool Lit() { return !thrown && UBQS_Data.Ext(frameNow) > 0.5 && InHand(); }
	bool Twirling() { return back && !thrown && !joined && !doused && UInt("ubqs_twirl", 2) > 0; }

	// ---- THE WRIST FLICK (ubqs_flick): a sharp twist of the wrist lights or douses the blade -------------------
	// The controller's roll, about the forearm, turning fast (ubqs_flick_deg over three tics) while the hand
	// itself stays put -- a twist, not a swing. Then a breath (20 tics) before the next.
	bool doused;              // the blade is off; the hilt is in your hand
	int  igniteAnim;          // tics left of the blade running out (lighting) or in (dousing)
	int  flickQuiet;
	double lastRoll, lastAimA, lastAimP;
	double rr0, rr1, rr2, ra0, ra1, ra2;
	int IgniteFrame()
	{
		static const int UP[] = { %(fr_n)d, %(fr_o)d, %(fr_p)d, %(fr_q)d };
		static const int DN[] = { %(fr_q)d, %(fr_p)d, %(fr_o)d, %(fr_n)d };
		int k = clamp(3 - (igniteAnim - 1) / 2, 0, 3);
		return doused ? DN[k] : UP[k];
	}
	void Flick()
	{
		if (thrown || merged || !owner) return;
		doused = !doused;
		ignited = !doused;
		igniteAnim = 8;
		owner.A_StartSound(doused ? "ubqs/off" : "ubqs/on", bOffhandWeapon ? CHAN_6 : CHAN_WEAPON);
		Buzz();
	}
	private void FlickCheck()
	{
		double r = HR(), a = HA(), pt = HP();
		double dr = DeltaAngle(lastRoll, r);
		double da = abs(DeltaAngle(lastAimA, a)) + abs(DeltaAngle(lastAimP, pt));
		lastRoll = r; lastAimA = a; lastAimP = pt;
		rr2 = rr1; rr1 = rr0; rr0 = dr;
		ra2 = ra1; ra1 = ra0; ra0 = da;
		if (flickQuiet > 0) { flickQuiet--; return; }
		return;      // the wrist flick is gone (the owner, 10-01: "remove wrist flick")
		if (abs(pt) > 65.0) return;                        // pointing straight up or down, roll is meaningless
		double twist = rr0 + rr1 + rr2;
		double need = UF("ubqs_flick_deg", 65.0);
		if (abs(twist) < need) return;
		if (ra0 + ra1 + ra2 > abs(twist) * 0.6) return;    // the hand swung as much as it twisted: a swing
		if (HandVel().Length() > 4.0) return;              // the arm is moving: a swing, not a flick
		Flick();
		flickQuiet = 20;
		rr0 = rr1 = rr2 = 0;
	}

	// ---- THE STAFF: hilts brought together butt to butt join into one double-bladed saber (ubqs_join) --------
	// Both lit, pointing opposite ways, the off hand right behind the main hand's pommel, for four tics: the
	// main hand holds the staff (both blades), the off hand's saber is part of it. Pull your hands apart and it
	// splits again.
	bool joined;              // main hand: holding the joined staff
	bool merged;              // off hand: this saber is part of the main hand's staff
	bool backBeforeJoin;
	int  joinTics, splitTics;
	UBQS_SaberBase OffSaber()
	{
		if (!owner) return null;
		return UBQS_SaberBase(owner.FindInventory("UBQS_SaberOff"));
	}
	private void JoinCheck()
	{
		let o = OffSaber();
		if (!UInt("ubqs_join", 1) || !o || !o.InHand() || o.thrown || thrown || !InHand())
		{
			if (joined) Unjoin(o);
			return;
		}
		Vector3 mh = HandPos(), oh = o.HandPos();
		if (joined)
		{
			if ((oh - mh).Length() > 30.0) { if (++splitTics >= 3) Unjoin(o); }
			else splitTics = 0;
			return;
		}
		if (doused || o.doused || !Lit() || !o.Lit()) { joinTics = 0; return; }
		Vector3 d = BladeDir(), od = o.BladeDir();
		Vector3 rel = oh - mh;
		double along = rel dot (-d);                        // how far the off hand is behind the main pommel line
		double side = (rel - (-d) * along).Length();        // and off that line
		bool lined = (d dot od) < -0.8 && along > 2.0 && along < 24.0 && side < 8.0;
		joinTics = lined ? joinTics + 1 : 0;
		if (joinTics >= 4) Join(o);
	}
	void Join(UBQS_SaberBase o)
	{
		joined = true;
		joinTics = splitTics = 0;
		backBeforeJoin = back;
		back = true;
		o.merged = true;
		o.ClearLocks();
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/catch", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0);
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/on", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.6);
		Buzz();
		o.Buzz();
	}
	void Unjoin(UBQS_SaberBase o)
	{
		if (!joined) return;
		joined = false;
		joinTics = splitTics = 0;
		back = backBeforeJoin;
		if (o) o.merged = false;
		if (owner) owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/catch", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.7);
	}
	UBQS_SaberBase Other()
	{
		if (!owner) return null;
		UBQS_SaberBase o;
		if (bOffhandWeapon) o = UBQS_SaberBase(owner.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber"));
		else o = UBQS_SaberBase(owner.FindInventory("UBQS_SaberOff"));
		if (o && o.Lit()) return o;
		return null;
	}

	// ---- EVERY TIC ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// THE HAND'S LAST FOUR POSITIONS, less the body's own motion: how the arm is really moving (the throw)
	Vector3 h0, h1, h2, h3;
	double lastYaw;
	Vector3 lastBodyPos;
	// WHERE THE BODY CARRIES THE HANDS: QuestZDoom puts the hands relative to the EYE, and the eye bobs as you
	// walk -- so the body's own motion is its feet's xy and its eye's height, as they actually moved this tic
	// (the owner, 10-01: "walking around causes the saber to register swings")
	Vector3 bodyNow, bodyStep;
	static Vector3 BodyAt(Actor o) { return (o.pos.x, o.pos.y, o.player ? o.player.viewz : o.pos.z + 41.0); }
	int snapQuiet;
	Vector3 HandVel()
	{
		// the fastest of the last three single-tic steps, so a quick flick counts as much as a long swing
		Vector3 a = h0 - h1, b = h1 - h2, c = h2 - h3;
		Vector3 v = a;
		if (b.Length() > v.Length()) v = b;
		if (c.Length() > v.Length()) v = c;
		return v;
	}

	override void DoEffect()
	{
		Super.DoEffect();
		if (!owner || !owner.player) return;
		int ch = bOffhandWeapon ? 21 : 20;
		h3 = h2; h2 = h1; h1 = h0;
		Vector3 bn = BodyAt(owner);
		bodyStep = bn - bodyNow;
		if (bodyStep.Length() > 48.0) bodyStep = (0, 0, 0);
		bodyNow = bn;
		h0 = HandPos() - bn;
		// A SNAP TURN (or a teleport) jumps the whole world-space arm around the body in one tic. That is not
		// a swing and not a throw (the owner, 10-01: "snap turn registers as an attack"): forget the motion history.
		double turned = abs(DeltaAngle(lastYaw, owner.angle));
		bool jumped = (owner.pos - lastBodyPos).Length() > 48.0;
		lastYaw = owner.angle;
		lastBodyPos = owner.pos;
		if (turned >= 8.0 || jumped)
		{
			h1 = h0; h2 = h0; h3 = h0;
			lastOk = false;
			snapQuiet = 2;
		}
		if (snapQuiet > 0) { snapQuiet--; lastOk = false; h1 = h0; h2 = h0; h3 = h0; }
		if (keepMarksUntil > 0 && level.maptime > keepMarksUntil) { keepMarksUntil = 0; ClearLocks(); }
		FlickCheck();
		// (the hilt join is gone -- the owner, 10-01: a phantom saber, and no gameplay in it)
		if (flashTics > 0 && --flashTics == 0 && flash) flash.Dark();
		if (clashQuiet > 0) clashQuiet--;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) burnQuiet--;
		if (swingQuiet > 0) swingQuiet--;
		if (!Lit())
		{
			if (!bOffhandWeapon) EndLock();
			if (humming) { owner.A_StopSound(ch); humming = false; }
			lastOk = false;
			Lights(false);
			BladeGlowOff();
			return;
		}
		if (!humming) { owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/hum", ch, CHANF_LOOPING, 0.45); humming = true; }

		Vector3 hand = BladeBase(), dir = BladeDir();
		double len = BladeLen();
		Vector3 tip = hand + dir * len;
		Vector3 pom = Pommel();
		// ubqs_diag 1: dots along the blade line the script uses, to check it sits on the blade you see
		if (UInt("ubqs_diag", 0) && (level.maptime & 1))
		{
			int dc = bOffhandWeapon ? 0x00FF00 : 0xFF00FF;
			for (int i = 0; i <= 8; i++) UBQS_Data.Glow(hand + dir * (len * i / 8.0), dc, 0.03, 1.0, 2);
		}
		// THE BLADE'S OWN SPEED, less the body's: walking is not swinging (the owner, 10-01: "it makes the swing
		// sound every time i take a step"). The hum rises a little with a real swing and stays steady otherwise.
		double speed = lastOk ? ((tip - lastTip) - bodyStep).Length() : 0.0;
		owner.A_SoundPitch(ch, 1.0 + clamp((speed - 6.0) / 60.0, 0.0, 0.3));
		owner.A_SoundVolume(ch, 0.45);

		// TWIRLING: the staff is a spinning disc in front of your hand -- it cuts what it touches and turns
		// every shot that crosses it. No line work, no burning (it would scorch circles into the wall).
		if (UBQS_Data.IsTwirl(frameNow))
		{
			if (!bOffhandWeapon) EndLock();
			lastFastTic = level.maptime;
			TwirlDisc(HandPos(), len);
			BladeGlowOff();
			lastTip = tip;
			lastBase = hand;
			lastOk = true;
			Lights(true);
			return;
		}
		// THE SWING IS YOUR ARM (the owner, 10-01): the blade cuts whatever your real swing passes it through,
		// harder the faster; a real swing whooshes, pitched by its speed, and leaves a glowing trail. The speed
		// is the blade tip's own, less the body's -- walking is not swinging.
		if (speed >= 8.0)
		{
			lastFastTic = level.maptime;
			CutAlong(speed);
			if (swingQuiet <= 0)
			{
				owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/swing", CHAN_AUTO, 0, clamp(speed / 24.0, 0.5, 1.0), ATTN_NORM, clamp(0.85 + speed / 60.0, 0.85, 1.35));
				swingQuiet = 8;
			}
		}
		if (speed >= 6.0 && lastOk && UInt("ubqs_trail", 1)) Trail(hand, tip, speed);
		if (UInt("ubqs_deflect", 1))
		{
			Deflect(hand, dir, len);
			if (back) Deflect(pom, -dir, len);
		}
		Burn(hand, dir, len);
		if (back) Burn(pom, -dir, len);
		if (!bOffhandWeapon) Clash(hand, dir, len);
		lastTip = tip;
		lastBase = hand;
		lastOk = true;
		Lights(true);
		BladeGlow(hand, dir, len, pom);
	}

	// ---- THE BLADE'S OWN GLOW (the owner, 10-01: "give the sabers a hot emissive core ... they look like
	// plastic toys"). The HUD model cannot be drawn additive, so the light around it is a row of soft CombatFX
	// glows in the blade's colour laid along the beam -- the bloom a film blade has. Five per blade, the same
	// actors moved every tic (never respawned); ubqs_blade_glow sets how strong (0 off).
	// THE SOFT GLOWING DOTS INSIDE THE BLADE (build 35's look -- the owner, 10-01: "and we had the soft glowing
	// dots inside of them"): five soft CombatFX glows in the blade's colour along each beam, in the world.
	private Array<UBQS_FX> bglow;
	private void BladeGlow(Vector3 base, Vector3 dir, double len, Vector3 pom)
	{
		// DENSER (the owner, 10-01: "make these beams denser with these emissives ... obscure the tube"): ten
		// overlapping glows down each beam instead of five spaced ones
		int N = 10;
		double str = 0.42;
		int want = (len > 2.0) ? (back ? N * 2 : N) : 0;
		while (bglow.Size() > want) { let g = bglow[bglow.Size() - 1]; if (g) g.Destroy(); bglow.Pop(); }
		if (want == 0) return;
		int rgb = UBQS_Data.Mix(RgbNow(), 0xFFFFFF, 0.15);
		double sc = 0.17;
		for (int i = 0; i < want; i++)
		{
			int k = i %% N;
			double t = 0.05 + 0.10 * k;
			Vector3 at = (i < N) ? base + dir * (len * t) : pom - dir * (len * t);
			if (i >= bglow.Size()) bglow.Push(UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXGL', 1, 1000, sc, str, rgb));
			let g = bglow[i];
			if (!g) continue;
			g.SetOrigin(at, true);
			g.life = g.total;
			g.scale = (sc, sc);
			g.a0 = str * (k == N - 1 ? 0.7 : 1.0);
			g.SetShade(rgb);
		}
	}
	private void BladeGlowOff()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < bglow.Size(); i++) if (bglow[i]) bglow[i].Destroy();
		bglow.Clear();
	}

	// ---- THE SWING TRAIL: the path the blade swept this tic, filled with fading glow (particles, no light) ----
	private void Trail(Vector3 base, Vector3 tip, double speed)
	{
		// soft glows of the blade's colour along the arc it swept -- a few a tic (Quest), gone in six
		int rgb = RgbNow();
		int steps = clamp(int(speed / 8.0), 1, 2);
		for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++)
		{
			double s = (i + 0.5) / steps;
			Vector3 b = lastBase + (base - lastBase) * s;
			Vector3 e = lastTip + (tip - lastTip) * s;
			UBQS_Data.Glow(b + (e - b) * 0.6, rgb, 0.10, 0.4, 6);
			UBQS_Data.Glow(b + (e - b) * 0.95, rgb, 0.12, 0.5, 6);
		}
	}

	// ---- CUT: whatever the blade is in ------------------------------------------------------------------
	void CutAlong(double speed)
	{
		Vector3 hand = BladeBase(), dir = BladeDir();
		double len = BladeLen();
		CutLine(hand, dir, len, speed);
		if (back) CutLine(Pommel(), -dir, len, speed);
	}
	private void CutLine(Vector3 base, Vector3 dir, double len, double speed)
	{
		if (len < 1) return;
		Vector3 mid = base + dir * (len * 0.5);
		double reach = len * 0.5 + 48.0;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(mid.x, mid.y, mid.z - reach, reach * 2.0, reach, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || !mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0) continue;
			if (mo.bFriendly && owner.player) continue;
			if (mo.player && !deathmatch) continue;
			int i = cutWho.Find(mo);
			if (i < cutWho.Size() && level.maptime - cutWhen[i] < 8) continue;
			Vector3 c = level.Vec3Diff(base, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			Vector3 blade = dir * len;
			double t = clamp((c dot blade) / (len * len), 0.0, 1.0);
			Vector3 gap = c - blade * t;
			if ((gap.xy).Length() > mo.radius + 3.0 || abs(gap.z) > mo.height * 0.5 + 3.0) continue;
			int dmg = int(UF("ubqs_damage", 30.0) * clamp(speed / 20.0, 0.5, 2.0));
			Vector3 at = level.Vec3Offset(base, blade * t);
			if (!mo.bNoBlood)
			{
				mo.SpawnBlood(at, VectorAngle(dir.x, dir.y), dmg);
				UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXHF', 10, 1, 0.12, 0.7, UBQS_Data.Mix(RgbNow(), 0xFFFFFF, 0.4));
			}
			else UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, -dir, RgbNow(), 6);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, owner, dmg, 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
			owner.A_StartSound(mo.bNoBlood ? "ubqs/wall" : "ubqs/hit", CHAN_AUTO);
			FlashAt(at, 56, 3);
			if (i < cutWho.Size()) cutWhen[i] = level.maptime;
			else { cutWho.Push(mo); cutWhen.Push(level.maptime); }
		}
		for (int k = cutWho.Size() - 1; k >= 0; k--)
			if (!cutWho[k] || cutWho[k].health <= 0) { cutWho.Delete(k); cutWhen.Delete(k); }
	}

	// ---- THE TWIRLING STAFF: a disc of blade, as wide as the blade is long, square to your hand's aim ---------
	private void TwirlDisc(Vector3 hand, double len)
	{
		if (len < 4) return;
		Vector3 n = Aim();
		double reach = len + 160.0;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hand.x, hand.y, hand.z - reach, reach * 2.0, reach, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner) continue;
			Vector3 c = level.Vec3Diff(hand, mo.pos);
			if (mo.bMissile)
			{
				if (mo.target == owner || mo is "UBQS_Thrown" || !UInt("ubqs_deflect", 1)) continue;
				// where its path this tic crosses the disc's plane, and whether that is inside the disc
				double a0 = c dot n, a1 = (c + mo.vel) dot n;
				if ((a0 > 0) == (a1 > 0) && min(abs(a0), abs(a1)) > mo.radius + 4.0) continue;
				double t = (abs(a0 - a1) > 0.001) ? clamp(a0 / (a0 - a1), 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
				Vector3 hit = c + mo.vel * t;
				if ((hit - n * (hit dot n)).Length() > len + mo.radius) continue;
				BatBack(mo, n);
				continue;
			}
			if (!mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || (mo.bFriendly && owner.player) || (mo.player && !deathmatch)) continue;
			Vector3 mid = c + (0, 0, mo.height * 0.5);
			double along = mid dot n;
			if (abs(along) > mo.radius + 6.0) continue;
			if ((mid - n * along).Length() > len + mo.radius) continue;
			int i = cutWho.Find(mo);
			if (i < cutWho.Size() && level.maptime - cutWhen[i] < 8) continue;
			int dmg = int(UF("ubqs_damage", 30.0) * 0.8);
			Vector3 at = level.Vec3Offset(hand, mid);
			if (!mo.bNoBlood) mo.SpawnBlood(at, VectorAngle(n.x, n.y), dmg);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, owner, dmg, 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
			owner.A_StartSound(mo.bNoBlood ? "ubqs/wall" : "ubqs/hit", CHAN_AUTO);
			if (i < cutWho.Size()) cutWhen[i] = level.maptime;
			else { cutWho.Push(mo); cutWhen.Push(level.maptime); }
		}
	}

	// ---- DEFLECT: a missile crossing the blade -- where it is now, where it was a tic ago, or between -------
	// The blade moves several units a tic when swung, so testing only where it is now lets fast bolts slip
	// through a fast swing. Three samples of the swept blade against the bolt's whole path this tic.
	void Deflect(Vector3 base, Vector3 dir, double len)
	{
		if (len < 1) return;
		Vector3 mid = base + dir * (len * 0.5);
		double reach = len * 0.5 + 300.0;          // fast bolts cover a lot of ground in a tic (two tics ahead)
		Vector3 pb = lastOk ? lastBase : base;
		Vector3 pt = lastOk ? lastTip : base + dir * len;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(mid.x, mid.y, mid.z - reach, reach * 2.0, reach, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || !mo.bMissile || mo == owner || mo.target == owner || mo is "UBQS_Thrown") continue;
			double near = 1e9;
			for (int k = 0; k <= 2; k++)
			{
				double t = k * 0.5;
				Vector3 b = pb + (base - pb) * t;
				Vector3 e = pt + ((base + dir * len) - pt) * t;
				// the shot's path from a tic back to two tics ahead: Wardust's bolts are fast enough to go from in
				// front of the blade to inside you between two checks (the owner, 10-01: one blade, held across,
				// did not deflect)
				near = min(near, UBQS_Data.SegSeg(level.Vec3Diff(b, mo.pos - mo.vel), mo.vel * 3.0, e - b));
			}
			if (near > mo.radius + 5.0) continue;
			BatBack(mo, dir);
		}
	}

	// WHERE A DEFLECTED SHOT GOES (ubqs_deflect_aim): 0 back at whoever fired it; 1 where you are LOOKING,
	// helped onto the nearest enemy inside a narrow cone of your gaze; 2 straight off the blade, a mirror.
	void BatBack(Actor mo, Vector3 blade)
	{
		Actor shooter = mo.target;
		double sp = max(mo.Speed, mo.vel.Length()) * 1.2;
		if (sp <= 0) sp = 12;
		Vector3 d = (0, 0, 0);
		int aim = UInt("ubqs_deflect_aim", 1);
		if (aim == 1)
		{
			Actor pick = GazeTarget(14.0);
			if (pick) d = level.Vec3Diff(mo.pos, (pick.pos.xy, pick.pos.z + pick.height * 0.55));
			else d = (cos(owner.angle) * cos(owner.pitch), sin(owner.angle) * cos(owner.pitch), -sin(owner.pitch));
		}
		else if (aim == 2)
		{
			Vector3 v = mo.vel.Unit();
			Vector3 n = (blade cross (v cross blade));
			if (n.Length() > 0.001) { n = n.Unit(); d = v - n * (2.0 * (v dot n)); }
		}
		if (d.Length() < 0.001 && shooter && shooter != owner && shooter.health > 0)
			d = level.Vec3Diff(mo.pos, (shooter.pos.xy, shooter.pos.z + shooter.height * 0.5));
		if (d.Length() < 0.001) d = -mo.vel;
		if (d.Length() < 0.001) d = (1, 0, 0);
		d = d.Unit();
		mo.target = owner;
		if (mo.bSeekerMissile) mo.tracer = shooter;
		mo.vel = d * sp;
		mo.angle = VectorAngle(d.x, d.y);
		mo.pitch = -asin(clamp(d.z, -1.0, 1.0));
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/deflect", CHAN_AUTO);
		UBQS_Data.Sparks(mo.pos, d, RgbNow(), 8);
		FlashAt(mo.pos, 64, 4);
	}

	// THE ENEMY YOU ARE LOOKING AT: the nearest live one inside `cone` degrees of your gaze, that you can see.
	Actor GazeTarget(double cone)
	{
		Vector3 eye = owner.Vec3Offset(0, 0, owner.player ? owner.player.viewheight : 41.0);
		Vector3 look = (cos(owner.angle) * cos(owner.pitch), sin(owner.angle) * cos(owner.pitch), -sin(owner.pitch));
		Actor best = null;
		double bestScore = 1e9;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(eye.x, eye.y, eye.z - 1536, 3072, 1536, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || !mo.bIsMonster || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bFriendly || mo == owner) continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(eye, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.55));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < 1 || dist > 1536) continue;
			double off = acos(clamp((to / dist) dot look, -1.0, 1.0));
			if (off > cone) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			double score = off * 40.0 + dist * 0.05;
			if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = mo; }
		}
		return best;
	}

	// ---- BLOCK: a hitscan shot (a trooper's rifle, a zombie's pistol) stopped by a lit blade facing it ------
	// Missiles are the deflect's; melee is not blocked. A blade swung in the last third of a second always
	// blocks; held still, ubqs_block percent of the time. A blocked shot can go back (ubqs_block_return).
	override void ModifyDamage(int damage, Name damageType, out int newdamage, bool passive, Actor inflictor, Actor source, int flags)
	{
		if (!passive || damage <= 0 || !owner) return;
		// THE CROSS GUARD (your two blades crossed in front of you, an X or a +): NOTHING from in front gets
		// through -- shots, bolts, claws, blasts. From behind, it does not help.
		if (Guarding())
		{
			Actor from = inflictor ? inflictor : source;
			if (from && from != owner)
			{
				double off = abs(DeltaAngle(owner.angle, VectorAngle(from.pos.x - owner.pos.x, from.pos.y - owner.pos.y)));
				if (off < 100.0)
				{
					newdamage = 0;
					owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/deflect", CHAN_AUTO);
					UBQS_ClashFlash.Burst(guardAt, 0.8);
					UBQS_Data.Sparks(guardAt, (0, 0, 1), 0xFFFFFF, 8);
					FlashAt(guardAt, 80, 3);
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		if (!Lit() || !source || source == owner) return;
		if (inflictor && inflictor.bMissile) return;
		if (owner.Distance3D(source) < 96) return;
		Vector3 aim = Aim();
		double toShooter = VectorAngle(source.pos.x - owner.pos.x, source.pos.y - owner.pos.y);
		if (abs(DeltaAngle(VectorAngle(aim.x, aim.y), toShooter)) > UF("ubqs_block_cone", 75.0)) return;
		bool swung = level.maptime - lastFastTic < 12;
		if (!swung && random[UBQSBlock](1, 100) > UInt("ubqs_block", 70)) return;
		newdamage = 0;
		Vector3 hand = BladeBase(), dir = BladeDir();
		Vector3 at = hand + dir * (BladeLen() * 0.6);
		Vector3 back = level.Vec3Diff(at, (source.pos.xy, source.pos.z + source.height * 0.55));
		if (back.Length() > 0.001) back = back.Unit();
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/deflect", CHAN_AUTO);
		UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, back, RgbNow(), 10);
		FlashAt(at, 64, 4);
		if (UInt("ubqs_block_return", 1))
		{
			let b = UBQS_Bolt(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Bolt", at));
			if (b)
			{
				b.target = owner;
				b.rgb = RgbNow();
				b.vel = back * b.Speed;
				b.angle = VectorAngle(back.x, back.y);
				b.pitch = -asin(clamp(back.z, -1.0, 1.0));
			}
		}
	}

	// ---- BURN: a blade pushed into a wall or the floor spits sparks and scorches it ----------------------
	private void Burn(Vector3 base, Vector3 dir, double len)
	{
		if (len < 4 || !UInt("ubqs_burn", 1)) return;
		let tr = new("UBQS_Tracer");
		Sector sec = level.PointInSector(base.xy);
		if (!tr.Trace(base, sec, dir, len, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, true)) return;
		if (tr.Results.HitType == TRACE_HitNone || tr.Results.HitType == TRACE_HitActor) return;
		Vector3 at = tr.Results.HitPos;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) return;
		burnQuiet = 5;
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/burn", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.7);
		if (tr.Results.HitType != TRACE_HitWall) return;
		// the scorch, sprayed from a hair in front of the wall (the flash light's actor, parked there dark)
		if (!flash) flash = UBQS_Light(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Light", at - dir * 4.0));
		if (!flash) return;
		flash.SetOrigin(at - dir * 4.0, false);
		flash.A_SprayDecal("UBQS_Burn", 16.0, (0, 0, 0), dir);
		UBQS_FX.Fx(at - dir * 1.5, 'UXEM', 1, 18, 0.14, 0.8, -1, 0.97);
	}

	// ---- CLASH: your two blades crossing -------------------------------------------------------------------
	// THE BLADES CROSSING, as at the end of Empire. FIRST CONTACT: Jedi Academy's blade-on-blade hit over an
	// electric crack, a white-hot starburst, a crack of light, sparks -- harder the faster they met. HELD
	// TOGETHER (a blade lock): a looping electric snarl, bursts and a flickering light every couple of tics, and a
	// fresh snap now and then -- until you pull them apart. Contact is entered at 3 units and left only past 7
	// (or after 4 tics apart), so a lock does not stutter in and out on a trembling hand.
	bool inLock;
	int guardUntil;
	Vector3 guardAt;
	int lockSince, lastTouch, nextSnap;
	Vector3 otherLastTip;
	double lastSide;
	bool sideOk;
	bool Guarding() { return !bOffhandWeapon && level.maptime <= guardUntil && UInt("ubqs_crossguard", 1); }
	// THE CROSSING'S LIGHT (the owner, 10-01, Empire's carbon-freeze fight: "a nice flash of light to obscure
	// the geometry of the blades overlapping"): a hot white core where the beams pass through each other, in
	// a halo of both blades' colours -- two soft CombatFX glows that stay on while the blades are together,
	// steady (no flicker), swelling on the first hit and settling. Gone the moment they part.
	UBQS_FX lockCore, lockHalo;
	double glowPop;
	private void LockGlow(Vector3 at, int orgb)
	{
		if (!lockCore) lockCore = UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXGL', 1, 1000, 0.2, 0.95, 0xFFFFFF);
		if (!lockHalo) lockHalo = UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXGL', 1, 1000, 0.45, 0.5, UBQS_Data.Mix(UBQS_Data.Mix(RgbNow(), orgb, 0.5), 0xFFFFFF, 0.25));
		double k = 1.0 + glowPop;
		glowPop *= 0.8;
		if (lockCore)
		{
			lockCore.SetOrigin(at, true);
			lockCore.life = lockCore.total;
			lockCore.scale = (0.2, 0.2) * k;
			lockCore.roll = 0;
		}
		if (lockHalo)
		{
			lockHalo.SetOrigin(at, true);
			lockHalo.life = lockHalo.total;
			lockHalo.scale = (0.45, 0.45) * k;
			lockHalo.roll = 0;
		}
	}
	private void LockGlowOff()
	{
		if (lockCore) lockCore.Destroy();
		if (lockHalo) lockHalo.Destroy();
		lockCore = null;
		lockHalo = null;
	}
	private void EndLock()
	{
		LockGlowOff();
		if (!inLock) return;
		inLock = false;
		owner.A_StopSound(22);
	}
	private void Clash(Vector3 base, Vector3 dir, double len)
	{
		let o = Other();
		if (!o || len < 4 || o.Twirling()) { EndLock(); sideOk = false; return; }
		Vector3 ob = o.BladeBase(), od = o.BladeDir();
		double ol = o.BladeLen();
		if (ol < 4) { EndLock(); sideOk = false; return; }
		Vector3 otip = ob + od * ol;
		double rel = (lastOk ? ((otip - otherLastTip) - ((base + dir * len) - lastTip)).Length() : 0.0);
		otherLastTip = otip;
		// CONTACT, the same whichever blade is on top and at any angle (the owner, 10-01: only one + sparked).
		// Blades are a few units thick and the hand's pose is a tic old, so contact is generous -- and a blade
		// that went clean THROUGH the other between two tics (the side it is on flipped) counted as a hit too.
		Vector3 sep = UBQS_Data.SegVec(level.Vec3Diff(ob, base), dir * len, od * ol);
		double gap = sep.Length();
		Vector3 n = dir cross od;
		double side = 0;
		bool crossed = false;
		if (n.Length() > 0.15)
		{
			side = sep dot (n / n.Length());
			crossed = sideOk && gap < 14.0 && abs(lastSide) < 14.0 && ((side > 0) != (lastSide > 0));
		}
		lastSide = side;
		sideOk = n.Length() > 0.15;
		// NOT AT THE HANDLES (the owner, 10-01: "handles are still giving me some shit"): a touch whose nearest
		// point is within a hand's breadth of either emitter is the hilts bumping, not the beams crossing
		double sa, sb;
		UBQS_Data.SegST(level.Vec3Diff(ob, base), dir * len, od * ol, sa, sb);
		// ...and only when BOTH are down at their emitters (the owner, 10-01: with either one, the bottom third
		// of the blade went inert). One beam's base across the other's blade is a real crossing.
		// both tunable in game (the owner, 10-01): ubqs_contact, how close the beams must come; ubqs_contact_hilt,
		// the dead zone up from the emitters where hilts bumping is ignored
		double hz = UF("ubqs_contact_hilt", 0.75), cz = UF("ubqs_contact", 3.5);
		bool nearHilt = sa * len < hz && sb * ol < hz;
		bool touching = !nearHilt && (crossed || gap <= (inLock ? cz * 1.7 : cz));
		if (UInt("ubqs_diag", 0)) Console.Printf("ubqs clash gap %%.1f side %%.1f %%s", gap, side, touching ? "HIT" : "");
		if (!touching)
		{
			LockGlowOff();
			if (inLock && level.maptime - lastTouch > 4) EndLock();
			return;
		}
		lastTouch = level.maptime;
		// WHERE THEY CROSS: halfway between the two blades' nearest points -- the crossing itself, wherever
		// along the blades it is (it was the point on this blade nearest the OTHER blade's middle, which
		// put the effect down at the hilts -- the owner, 10-01)
		Vector3 at = ((base + dir * (len * sa)) + (ob + od * (ol * sb))) * 0.5;
		// THE CROSS GUARD: blades held crossed, an X or a +, are a wall (ModifyDamage below)
		guardUntil = level.maptime + 2;
		guardAt = at;
		if (!inLock)
		{
			inLock = true;
			lockSince = level.maptime;
			nextSnap = level.maptime + random[UBQSFx](10, 18);
			double hard = clamp(rel / 12.0, 0.6, 1.6);
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/clash", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0);
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/crack", CHAN_AUTO, 0, clamp(0.5 + hard * 0.3, 0.6, 1.0));
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/bladelock", 22, CHANF_LOOPING, 0.3);
			UBQS_ClashFlash.Burst(at, hard);
			UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, (0, 0, 1), 0xFFFFFF, int(14 * hard));
			UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, (0, 0, 1), RgbNow(), 6);
			FlashAt(at, 80 + 30 * hard, 4);
			glowPop = 0.8 + 0.4 * hard;
			LockGlow(at, o.RgbNow());
			return;
		}
		LockGlow(at, o.RgbNow());
		// THE LOCK: the snarl swells in as they stay together
		owner.A_SoundVolume(22, 0.3 + clamp((level.maptime - lockSince) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.6);
		if ((level.maptime & 1) == 0)
		{
			UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXLT', 4, 1, frandom[UBQSFx](0.2, 0.32), 0.9);
			if (random[UBQSFx](0, 3) == 0) UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, (0, 0, 1), 0xFFFFFF, 4);
			FlashAt(at, frandom[UBQSFx](50, 96), 2);
		}
		if (level.maptime >= nextSnap)
		{
			nextSnap = level.maptime + random[UBQSFx](9, 20);
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/clash", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.55);
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/crack", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.5);
			UBQS_ClashFlash.Burst(at, 1.0);
			UBQS_Data.Sparks(at, (0, 0, 1), 0xFFFFFF, 8);
		}
		// a hard knock while locked is a fresh clash
		if (rel > 14.0) { inLock = false; owner.A_StopSound(22); }
	}

	// ---- THE THROW -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void Throw()
	{
		if (thrown || !owner) { ClearLocks(); return; }
		bool wasStaff = joined;
		if (joined) Unjoin(OffSaber());
		Vector3 hand = HandPos();
		let t = UBQS_Thrown(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Thrown", hand));
		if (!t) { ClearLocks(); return; }
		t.target = owner;
		t.master = owner;
		t.launcher = self;
		t.col = ColIdx();
		// THE SECOND BLADE LIGHTS AS IT LEAVES YOUR HAND (ubqs_throw_double): a staff spinning is the throw
		t.dbl = back || wasStaff || UInt("ubqs_throw_double", 1);
		t.bladeLen = FullLen();
		for (int i = 0; i < locks.Size(); i++) if (locks[i]) t.route.Push(locks[i]);
		locks.Clear();
		// THE SPIN PLANE (ubqs_throw_plane): 0 your wrist decides -- thrown with the hand upright it goes end
		// over end, turned on its side it goes flat; 1 always flat; 2 always end over end
		int plane = UInt("ubqs_throw_plane", 0);
		double r = abs(HR());
		bool vert = (plane == 2) || (plane == 0 && (r < 45.0 || r > 135.0));
		// THE ARM'S OWN THROW: its speed and direction at the moment it let go. A hard throw flies fast and far,
		// along your swing (steadied toward where the hand points). Locked enemies are always flown to.
		Vector3 d = Aim();
		double flySpeed = 26.0, range = UF("ubqs_throw_range", 512.0);
		Vector3 hv = HandVel();
		double sp = hv.Length();
		if (t.route.Size() == 0 && sp > 0.5)
		{
			d = (hv.Unit() * 0.6 + d * 0.4).Unit();
			flySpeed = clamp(16.0 + sp * 4.0, 22.0, 44.0);
			range *= clamp(sp / 4.0, 0.8, 1.6);
		}
		t.Speed = flySpeed;
		t.range = range;
		t.Launch(d, vert);
		thrown = t;
		Lights(false);
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/swing", CHAN_WEAPON);
	}
	// BACK IN THE HAND: it lights again as it lands
	void Caught()
	{
		thrown = null;
		doused = false;
		ignited = true;
		igniteAnim = 0;
		if (owner)
		{
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/catch", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.8);
		}
	}

	// ---- LIGHT ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// ubqs_lights: 0 none; 1 QUEST -- one light per saber, mid-blade, and when your two blades are close
	// together only the main hand's lights them both; 2 two per blade; 3 three per blade (PC).
	// Every light is one attached light on a reused actor, moved, never respawned.
	private void Lights(bool on)
	{
		int mode = on ? UInt("ubqs_lights", 1) : 0;
		int want = clamp(mode, 0, 3);
		if (want == 1 && bOffhandWeapon)
		{
			let o = Other();
			if (o && (o.HandPos() - HandPos()).Length() < 40.0) want = 0;
		}
		while (glow.Size() > want)
		{
			let l = glow[glow.Size() - 1];
			if (l) l.Destroy();
			glow.Pop();
		}
		if (want == 0) return;
		Vector3 hand = HandPos(), dir = BladeDir();
		double len = BladeLen();
		hand = BladeBase();
		if (back) { Vector3 pm = Pommel(); double full = (hand + dir * len - (pm - dir * len)).Length(); hand = pm - dir * len; len = full; }   // a staff: the light runs the whole double blade
		int rgb = RgbNow();
		double rad = (want == 1) ? 26.0 + len * 0.85 : ((want == 2) ? 18.0 + len * 0.6 : 14.0 + len * 0.45);
		for (int k = 0; k < want; k++)
		{
			double t = (want == 1) ? 0.45 : ((want == 2) ? 0.25 + 0.5 * k : 0.15 + 0.35 * k);
			Vector3 at = hand + dir * (len * t);
			if (k >= glow.Size()) glow.Push(UBQS_Light(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Light", at)));
			let l = glow[k];
			if (!l) continue;
			l.SetOrigin(at, true);
			l.Look(rgb, rad);
		}
	}
	// A SHORT FLASH: a hit, a block, a clash, a burn. One light, reused, a few tics.
	void FlashAt(Vector3 at, double rad, int tics)
	{
		if (UInt("ubqs_lights", 1) <= 0) return;
		if (!flash) flash = UBQS_Light(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Light", at));
		if (!flash) return;
		flash.SetOrigin(at, false);
		flash.Look(0xFFF0E0, rad);
		flashTics = max(flashTics, tics);
	}
	private void KillLights()
	{
		BladeGlowOff();
		for (int k = 0; k < glow.Size(); k++) if (glow[k]) glow[k].Destroy();
		glow.Clear();
		if (flash) flash.Destroy();
		flash = null;
		if (lockCore) lockCore.Destroy();
		if (lockHalo) lockHalo.Destroy();
	}
	override void OnDestroy()
	{
		KillLights();
		ClearLocks();
		if (thrown) thrown.Destroy();
		Super.OnDestroy();
	}
	override void DetachFromOwner()
	{
		KillLights();
		if (owner) owner.A_StopSound(bOffhandWeapon ? 21 : 20);
		humming = false;
		ignited = false;
		if (joined) Unjoin(OffSaber());
		merged = false;
		Super.DetachFromOwner();
	}

	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBPK A -1;
		Stop;
	Select:
		UBSP R 1 { A_UBShow(%(fr_r)d); A_Raise(12); }
		Loop;
	Deselect:
		UBSP Q 1 { A_UBShow(%(fr_q)d); A_UBOff(); }
		UBSP P 1 A_UBShow(%(fr_p)d);
		UBSP O 1 A_UBShow(%(fr_o)d);
		UBSP N 1 A_UBShow(%(fr_n)d);
	DeselectLoop:
		UBSP R 1 { A_UBShow(%(fr_r)d); A_Lower(12); }
		Loop;
	Ready:
		UBSP N 2 { A_UBShow(%(fr_n)d); A_UBOn(); }
		UBSP O 2 A_UBShow(%(fr_o)d);
		UBSP P 2 A_UBShow(%(fr_p)d);
		UBSP Q 2 A_UBShow(%(fr_q)d);
	ReadyLoop:
		UBSP AAA 1 A_UBReady(0);
		UBSP BBB 1 A_UBReady(1);
		UBSP CCC 1 A_UBReady(2);
		Loop;
	// FIRE: hold to lock on, throw with your arm (the swing itself is the attack -- see DoEffect)
	Fire:
		UBSP A 0 { A_UBShow(0); return A_UBHoldBegin(); }
	FireHold:
		UBSP A 1 { A_UBShow(0); return A_UBHold(); }
		Loop;
	// ALT: the Force push (ubqs_alt 1), or the second blade (ubqs_alt 0)
	AltFire:
		UBSP A 0 { A_UBShow(0); return A_UBAltFire(); }
	AltDone:
		UBSP A 8 A_UBShow(0);
		Goto ReadyLoop;
	// NEVER ENTERED. The engine registers a sprite name only when some state uses it, and MODELDEF stops
	// the game on a name it does not know -- so every size x colour x blades name the psprite is switched
	// to, and the thrown saber's, is named here once.
	GlowHold:
		G3BS A -1 Bright;
		Stop;
	Register:
%(register)s
		Stop;
	}
}

class UBQS_Saber : UBQS_SaberBase {}
class UBQS_SaberOff : UBQS_SaberBase
{
	Default
	{
		+WEAPON.OFFHANDWEAPON
		Weapon.SelectionOrder 2101;
	}
}

// ---- THE CLASH FLASH: a white-hot starburst where two blades meet -----------------------------------------
// One additive, fullbright billboard that blooms and fades in a fifth of a second. No light of its own (the
// saber's flash light does that), so it costs a sprite.
class UBQS_HapticPuff : Actor
{
	Default { +NOINTERACTION +NOBLOCKMAP +BLOODLESSIMPACT +PAINLESS +NODAMAGETHRUST -ALWAYSPUFF RenderStyle "None"; }
	States { Spawn: TNT1 A 1; Stop; }
}

// ---- ONE COMBATFX EFFECT: a sprite (the owner's CombatFX set) played through its frames, growing and fading,
// gone when done. Additive; shade >= 0 draws a grey mask in that colour (AddShaded). No engine particles.
class UBQS_FX : Actor
{
	int life, total, tpf, nfr;
	double a0, grow;
	bool rev;
	Default
	{
		RenderStyle "Add";
		Radius 1;
		Height 1;
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+BRIGHT
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+FORCEXYBILLBOARD
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTELEPORT
		+ROLLSPRITE
		+ROLLCENTER
	}
	static UBQS_FX Fx(Vector3 at, Name spr, int nfr, int tpf, double sc, double a = 1.0, int shade = -1, double grow = 1.0, bool rev = false)
	{
		let f = UBQS_FX(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_FX", at));
		if (!f) return null;
		f.sprite = GetSpriteIndex(spr);
		f.nfr = max(nfr, 1);
		f.tpf = max(tpf, 1);
		f.total = f.nfr * f.tpf;
		f.life = f.total;
		f.rev = rev;
		f.frame = rev ? f.nfr - 1 : 0;
		f.scale = (sc, sc);
		f.a0 = a;
		f.alpha = a;
		f.grow = grow;
		f.roll = frandom[UBQSFx](0, 360);
		if (shade >= 0)
		{
			f.A_SetRenderStyle(a, STYLE_AddShaded);
			f.SetShade(shade);
		}
		return f;
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		if (isFrozen()) return;
		if (--life < 0) { Destroy(); return; }
		int k = clamp((total - life - 1) / tpf, 0, nfr - 1);
		frame = rev ? nfr - 1 - k : k;
		if (grow != 1.0) scale *= grow;
		double t = life / double(total);
		alpha = (nfr == 1) ? a0 * t : a0 * min(1.0, t * 2.5);
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UXSP A -1 Bright;
		Stop;
	Register:
		UXST A 0;
		UXLT A 0;
		UXHF A 0;
		UXRG A 0;
		UXPL A 0;
		UXGL A 0;
		UXEM A 0;
		UXRE A 0;
		Stop;
	}
}

// ---- THE BEAM'S GLOW SHELL: an additive model of crossed planes laid along a blade (ubqs.py beamglow_md3).
// Model +Z is the beam: turned by the actor's angle and pitch (models.cpp: +Z goes to
// (sin p cos a, sin p sin a, cos p)), so pitch = acos(dir.z), angle = the beam's heading. Scale.Y stretches
// it to the beam's length (the mesh is 64 long), Scale.X sets its width.
class UBQS_BeamGlow : Actor
{
	Default
	{
		RenderStyle "Add";
		Alpha 0.6;
		Radius 1;
		Height 1;
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTELEPORT
		+BRIGHT
		+INTERPOLATEANGLES
	}
	// the saber says where (in its DoEffect); the glow moves there in its OWN tick, after the engine has kept
	// last tic's place and angles -- so the renderer slides it between tics instead of jumping
	Vector3 wFrom, wDir;
	double wLen, wW, wA;
	int wCol, wQ;
	bool wSet, laid;
	void Want(Vector3 from, Vector3 dir, double length, double w, int col, int q, double a)
	{
		wFrom = from; wDir = dir; wLen = length; wW = w; wCol = col; wQ = q; wA = a;
		wSet = true;
		if (!laid) { Lay(from, dir, length, w, col, q, a); ClearInterpolation(); laid = true; }
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed || !wSet) return;
		Lay(wFrom, wDir, wLen, wW, wCol, wQ, wA);
	}
	void Lay(Vector3 from, Vector3 dir, double length, double w, int col, int q, double a)
	{
		static const String SPR[] = { "UBG2", "UBG3", "UBG4", "UBG6" };
		SetOrigin(from, true);
		angle = VectorAngle(dir.x, dir.y);
		pitch = acos(clamp(dir.z, -1.0, 1.0));
		scale = (w, max(length, 0.5) / 64.0);
		sprite = GetSpriteIndex(SPR[clamp(q, 1, 4) - 1]);
		frame = col;
		alpha = a;
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBG3 A -1 Bright;
		Stop;
	Register:
		UBG2 A 0;
		UBG4 A 0;
		UBG6 A 0;
		Stop;
	}
}

class UBQS_ClashFlash : Actor
{
	int life;
	double grow;
	Default
	{
		RenderStyle "Add";
		Alpha 1.0;
		Scale 0.12;
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+BRIGHT
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+FORCEXYBILLBOARD
		+ROLLSPRITE
	}
	static void Burst(Vector3 at, double size)
	{
		UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXST', 1, 7, 0.09 * size, 1.0, -1, 1.0 + 0.1 * size);
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		if (--life <= 0) { Destroy(); return; }
		scale *= grow;
		alpha = life / 6.0;
	}
	States { Spawn: UBCF A -1 Bright; Stop; }
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE THROWN SABER: a real model in the room. Hold alt to paint up to ubqs_locks enemies in front of your
// hand, let go to throw -- it flies to each in turn, Captain America style, cutting them, then comes home.
// Nothing painted: it flies straight out to ubqs_throw_range. It spins in the plane you choose (ubqs_throw_plane:
// your wrist decides, flat like a disc, or end over end), lights its second blade as it leaves your hand,
// turns shots it passes, and burns a trail into any wall or floor its blades touch. Then (ubqs_throw 0) it
// comes back to your hand, or (1) drops: a saber that drops, or cannot get home, falls, lies flat and SHUTS
// OFF. Fire or alt fire calls it back -- a Force pull: it lights, lifts and flies to you. Walk over it to take it.
//
// IT MOVES ITSELF, with TryMove and +THRUACTORS: monsters do not stop it (the spinning blade cuts them),
// walls do. The engine's own Tick still runs every tic with no speed, so the renderer has last tic's position
// and angles and slides the model between them -- a 90 Hz spin, not a 35 Hz one.
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Thrown : Actor
{
	enum EPhase { PH_OUT, PH_ROUTE, PH_HOME, PH_FALL, PH_REST, PH_PULL }

	UBQS_SaberBase launcher;
	int    col;
	bool   dbl;
	double bladeLen;
	int    phase;
	int    age, phaseAge;
	Array<Actor> route;
	int    leg;
	bool   legHit;
	Vector3 dir;              // where it is flying, unit
	double flown;
	double fallV;
	double range;
	Vector3 drift;            // a lob's sideways motion, as it falls
	bool   vertical;          // spin end over end (else flat, like a disc)
	double spinPhase;
	int    burnQuiet;
	private Array<Actor> cutWho;
	private Array<int>   cutWhen;
	private int    litRgb;
	private int    litRad;

	Default
	{
		Radius 6;
		Height 6;
		Speed 26;
		+NOGRAVITY
		+THRUACTORS
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTELEPORT
		+NOTRIGGER
		+DROPOFF
		+NOBLOCKMONST
		+INTERPOLATEANGLES
		DamageType "Saber";
		Obituary "%%o was cut down by %%k's thrown lightsaber.";
	}

	void Launch(Vector3 d, bool vert)
	{
		dir = d;
		vertical = vert;
		angle = VectorAngle(d.x, d.y);
		spinPhase = angle;
		leg = 0;
		SetPhase(route.Size() > 0 ? PH_ROUTE : PH_OUT);
		if (phase == PH_ROUTE) NextLeg(false);
	}

	// A LOB: let go with the hand barely moving -- it tumbles out of your hand and falls where it lands
	void Lob(Vector3 v)
	{
		dir = (v.Length() > 0.01) ? v.Unit() : (cos(angle), sin(angle), 0);
		vertical = true;
		drift = (v.x, v.y, 0);
		fallV = -max(v.z, 0.0);
		SetPhase(PH_FALL);
	}

	bool IsLit() { return phase != PH_REST && !(phase == PH_FALL && phaseAge >= 6); }
	private void SetPhase(int p) { phase = p; phaseAge = 0; }

	// THE FORCE PULL (fire or alt fire with the saber out of your hand)
	void Recall()
	{
		if (phase == PH_PULL || phase == PH_HOME) return;
		if (phase == PH_REST) A_StartSound("ubqs/on", CHAN_BODY, 0, 0.7);     // a dark saber relighting
		ClearRoute();
		SetPhase(PH_PULL);
	}

	private void ClearRoute()
	{
		route.Clear();
		UBQS_LockMark.ClearAll(launcher);
	}

	// THE NEXT LIVING TARGET ON THE ROUTE, or the way home when there are none left
	private void NextLeg(bool advance)
	{
		if (advance) leg++;
		legHit = false;
		cutWho.Clear();
		cutWhen.Clear();
		while (leg < route.Size())
		{
			Actor t = route[leg];
			if (t && t.health > 0 && t.bShootable) return;
			leg++;
		}
		ClearRoute();
		Done();
	}
	// THE THROW IS OVER: home, or down where it is (ubqs_throw)
	private void Done()
	{
		if (UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_throw", 0) == 0) SetPhase(PH_HOME);
		else { fallV = 0; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
	}

	override void Tick()
	{
		if (!launcher || !master || master.health <= 0 || launcher.owner != master)
		{
			UBQS_LockMark.ClearAll(launcher);
			if (launcher && launcher.thrown == self) launcher.thrown = null;
			Destroy();
			return;
		}
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		age++;
		phaseAge++;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) burnQuiet--;
		if (age > 35 * 12 && phase < PH_HOME) { ClearRoute(); Done(); }
		double sp = Speed;
		switch (phase)
		{
		case PH_OUT:
			if (!Fly(dir * sp)) { Bang(); ClearRoute(); Done(); break; }
			flown += sp;
			if (flown >= (range > 0 ? range : UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_throw_range", 512.0))) Done();
			break;
		case PH_ROUTE:
		{
			Actor t = (leg < route.Size()) ? route[leg] : null;
			if (!t || t.health <= 0 || legHit) { NextLeg(true); break; }
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(pos, (t.pos.xy, t.pos.z + t.height * 0.5));
			double d = to.Length();
			if (d < t.radius + 10.0) { legHit = true; break; }
			dir = to / max(d, 0.001);
			// a wall in the way: it slips past (the Force), rather than drop the route
			bNoClip = false;
			if (!Fly(dir * min(sp * 1.15, d)))
			{
				Bang();
				bNoClip = true;
				Fly(dir * min(sp, d));
			}
			else bNoClip = false;
			break;
		}
		case PH_HOME:
		case PH_PULL:
		{
			// HOME, to the hand wherever it has gone. Through walls if it must: the Force does not path-find.
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(pos, launcher.HandPos());
			double d = to.Length();
			if (d < 26.0) { Catch(); return; }
			double hs = (phase == PH_PULL) ? min(10.0 + phaseAge * 2.0, 34.0) : 30.0;
			Vector3 step = to / d * min(hs, d);
			if (phase == PH_PULL && phaseAge < 8) step = (0, 0, 3.0);        // it lifts off the floor first
			else dir = to / d;
			bNoClip = true;
			Fly(step);
			if (phase == PH_HOME && phaseAge > 140) { fallV = 0; bNoClip = false; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
			break;
		}
		case PH_FALL:
		{
			bNoClip = false;
			if (drift.Length() > 0.05)
			{
				if (!TryMove(pos.xy + drift.xy, true)) drift = (0, 0, 0);
				drift *= 0.92;
			}
			fallV = min(fallV + 1.0, 20.0);
			double z = pos.z - fallV;
			if (z <= floorz)
			{
				z = floorz;
				SetPhase(PH_REST);
				A_StartSound("ubqs/drop", CHAN_BODY);
				A_StartSound("ubqs/off", CHAN_AUTO);
			}
			SetOrigin((pos.xy, z), true);
			break;
		}
		case PH_REST:
			// lying flat and dark; walk over it to take it back
			if (Distance2D(master) < master.radius + 24 && abs(master.pos.z - pos.z) < 48) { Catch(); return; }
			if (pos.z > floorz + 0.5) { fallV = 0; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
			break;
		}
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		Look();
		if (!IsLit()) return;
		if (age %% 9 == 1) A_StartSound("ubqs/spin", CHAN_BODY, 0, 0.8);
		SpinCut();
		SpinDeflect();
		BurnTrail();
	}

	// ONE STEP: up or down first (clamped to the room), then across with TryMove, which walls stop and
	// monsters (+THRUACTORS) do not. False when a wall stopped it.
	private bool Fly(Vector3 step)
	{
		double z = clamp(pos.z + step.z, floorz, max(floorz, ceilingz - height));
		bool hitFlat = !bNoClip && abs((pos.z + step.z) - z) > 0.5;
		SetZ(z);
		if (!TryMove(pos.xy + step.xy, true)) return false;
		if (hitFlat) { Bang(); return false; }
		return true;
	}
	// A WALL OR THE FLOOR IN THE WAY: a clang, at most every few tics (no sparks -- the owner, 10-01)
	private int bangQuiet;
	private void Bang()
	{
		if (level.maptime - bangQuiet < 6) return;
		bangQuiet = level.maptime;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/wall", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.7);
	}

	private void Catch()
	{
		Glow(false);
		ClearRoute();
		if (launcher) launcher.Caught();
		Destroy();
	}

	// THE BLADE'S DIRECTION as it is drawn this tic (the model's +X), from its angle and pitch
	Vector3 BladeVec() { return (cos(pitch) * cos(angle), cos(pitch) * sin(angle), -sin(pitch)); }

	// THE LOOK: lit and spinning in the air, still and dark at rest.
	private void Look()
	{
		double spin = UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_throw_spin", 14.0);
		if (phase == PH_REST) { pitch = 0; roll = 0; }
		else
		{
			double rate = (phase == PH_FALL) ? spin * max(0.0, 1.0 - phaseAge / 25.0) : spin;
			spinPhase += rate;
			if (vertical) { angle = VectorAngle(dir.x, dir.y); pitch = spinPhase; }
			else { angle = spinPhase; pitch = (phase == PH_FALL) ? pitch * 0.85 : -6.0; }
		}
		String sn = String.Format("U%%s%%sT", UBQS_Data.Col(col), dbl ? "D" : "S");
		sprite = GetSpriteIndex(sn);
		frame = IsLit() ? 0 : 1;
		Glow(IsLit());
	}

	// ONE ATTACHED LIGHT while lit (none when ubqs_lights is 0), re-attached only when it changes
	private void Glow(bool on)
	{
		int rgb = 0, rad = 0;
		if (on && UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_lights", 1) > 0) { rgb = UBQS_Data.Rgb(col); rad = int(24.0 + bladeLen * 0.9) / 4 * 4; }
		if (rgb == litRgb && rad == litRad) return;
		litRgb = rgb;
		litRad = rad;
		A_RemoveLight('UBQS');
		if (rad > 0) A_AttachLight('UBQS', DynamicLight.PointLight, rgb, rad, 0, DynamicLight.LF_ATTENUATE);
	}

	// THE TRAIL: a blade that reaches a wall, the floor or the ceiling as it spins scorches it (no sparks --
	// the owner, 10-01). One trace per blade per tic; one scorch every three tics at most (decals are not free).
	private void BurnTrail()
	{
		if (!UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_burn", 1)) return;
		Vector3 b = BladeVec();
		BurnAlong(b);
		if (dbl) BurnAlong(-b);
	}
	private void BurnAlong(Vector3 d)
	{
		let tr = new("UBQS_Tracer");
		if (!tr.Trace(pos, CurSector, d, bladeLen, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, true)) return;
		int ht = tr.Results.HitType;
		if (ht == TRACE_HitNone || ht == TRACE_HitActor) return;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) return;
		burnQuiet = 3;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/burn", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.6);
		A_SprayDecal("UBQS_Burn", bladeLen + 8.0, (0, 0, 0), d);
		if (ht == TRACE_HitWall) UBQS_FX.Fx(tr.Results.HitPos - d * 1.5, 'UXEM', 1, 18, 0.14, 0.8, -1, 0.97);
	}

	// THE SPINNING BLADE: a disc as wide as the blade is long, around wherever it is
	private void SpinCut()
	{
		double reach = bladeLen;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.Create(self, reach + 32.0);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == master || mo == self || !mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0) continue;
			if (mo.bFriendly && master.player) continue;
			if (mo.player && !deathmatch) continue;
			if (Distance2D(mo) > reach + mo.radius) continue;
			double mz = mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5;
			if (abs(mz - pos.z) > mo.height * 0.5 + reach * (vertical ? 1.0 : 0.3)) continue;
			int i = cutWho.Find(mo);
			if (i < cutWho.Size() && level.maptime - cutWhen[i] < 10) continue;
			int dmg = int(UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_damage", 30.0) * 1.5);
			if (!mo.bNoBlood) mo.SpawnBlood((mo.pos.xy, mz), angle, dmg);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, master, dmg, 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
			A_StartSound(mo.bNoBlood ? "ubqs/wall" : "ubqs/hit", CHAN_AUTO);
			if (phase == PH_ROUTE && leg < route.Size() && route[leg] == mo) legHit = true;
			if (i < cutWho.Size()) cutWhen[i] = level.maptime;
			else { cutWho.Push(mo); cutWhen.Push(level.maptime); }
		}
		for (int k = cutWho.Size() - 1; k >= 0; k--)
			if (!cutWho[k] || cutWho[k].health <= 0) { cutWho.Delete(k); cutWhen.Delete(k); }
	}
	private void SpinDeflect()
	{
		if (!UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_deflect", 1)) return;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.Create(self, bladeLen + 64.0);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || !mo.bMissile || mo == self || mo.target == master || mo is "UBQS_Thrown") continue;
			if (Distance3D(mo) < bladeLen + mo.radius) launcher.BatBack(mo, BladeVec());
		}
	}

	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBST A -1;
		Stop;
	}
}

// ---- THE LOCK MARK: a diamond over each enemy you painted ------------------------------------------------
class UBQS_LockMark : Actor
{
	Actor who;          // the saber it was painted for
	Default
	{
		Scale 0.35;
		Alpha 0.95;
		RenderStyle "Add";
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+BRIGHT
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+FORCEXYBILLBOARD
	}
	static void MarkFor(Actor saber, Actor target)
	{
		if (!target) return;
		let m = UBQS_LockMark(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_LockMark", (target.pos.xy, target.pos.z + target.height + 8)));
		if (m) { m.tracer = target; m.who = saber; }
	}
	static void ClearAll(Actor saber)
	{
		let it = ThinkerIterator.Create("UBQS_LockMark");
		UBQS_LockMark m;
		while (m = UBQS_LockMark(it.Next()))
			if (!saber || m.who == saber) m.Destroy();
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Super.Tick();
		if (!who || !tracer || tracer.health <= 0) { Destroy(); return; }
		SetOrigin((tracer.pos.xy, tracer.pos.z + tracer.height + 8), true);
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBLK ABCD 3 Bright;
		Loop;
	}
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE FORCE: one item every saber-carrier holds. It owns the push (both hands share its cooldown), and reads
// the OFF HAND's gestures -- the off-hand saber's alt held, or with no off-hand saber the bare Force hand's
// trigger -- and the Force jump.
//   THRUST the hand out, held:  PUSH (along your thrust).
//   YANK it back to you, held:  PULL -- enemies stagger in, pickups fly to your hand, a thrown saber comes home.
//   HOLD it still on an enemy:  GRIP -- it rises, choking, and hangs where your hand points; move your hand and
//                               it moves; let go mid-swing and it is FLUNG (and hurts when it hits).
//   HOLD JUMP:                  a FORCE JUMP -- higher, and a floating fall while jump stays held.
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Force : Inventory
{
	int pushReady;
	Vector3 h0, h1, h2, h3;
	double lastYaw;
	Vector3 lastBody;
	bool armed, fired;
	int armTics, lastScan;
	// the grip
	Actor gripped;
	UBQS_GripGlow gripGlow;
	double gripDist, dmgAcc;
	bool gripNoGrav;
	State gripPain;
	int gripSince;
	// a flung body, watched for the moment it hits something
	Actor slamMo;
	int slamTics;
	double slamLast;
	// things pulled toward you
	Array<Actor> pulled;
	Array<int> pulledUntil;
	// the jump
	int airTics;
	bool boostOk;

	Default
	{
		Inventory.MaxAmount 1;
		+INVENTORY.UNDROPPABLE
		+INVENTORY.UNTOSSABLE
		+INVENTORY.UNCLEARABLE
	}
	static UBQS_Force Of(Actor who)
	{
		if (!who) return null;
		let f = UBQS_Force(who.FindInventory("UBQS_Force"));
		if (!f) f = UBQS_Force(who.GiveInventoryType("UBQS_Force"));
		return f;
	}
	double FV(String n, double fb) { return UBQS_Data.F(owner, n, fb); }
	int IV(String n, int fb) { return UBQS_Data.I(owner, n, fb); }

	// ---- THE OFF HAND ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Vector3 OffPos()
	{
		Vector3 p = owner.OffhandPos;
		if (p == (0, 0, 0)) p = owner.Vec3Offset(0, 0, owner.player ? owner.player.viewheight * 0.8 : 40.0);
		return p;
	}
	Vector3 OffAim()
	{
		double a = owner.OffhandAngle + 90.0, p = -owner.OffhandPitch;
		return (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
	}
	Vector3 ViewFwd()
	{
		double a = owner.angle, p = owner.pitch;
		return (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
	}
	Vector3 HandVel()
	{
		Vector3 a = h0 - h1, b = h1 - h2, c = h2 - h3;
		Vector3 v = a;
		if (b.Length() > v.Length()) v = b;
		if (c.Length() > v.Length()) v = c;
		return v;
	}
	void Buzz()
	{
		if (owner && owner.player) owner.LineAttack(owner.angle, 1, -90, 1, 'UBQS_Haptic', 'UBQS_HapticPuff', 256);
	}

	override void DoEffect()
	{
		Super.DoEffect();
		if (!owner || !owner.player || owner.health <= 0) { if (gripped) EndGrip(false); return; }
		let p = owner.player;
		// the off hand's last four positions, less the body; a snap turn or teleport forgets them
		h3 = h2; h2 = h1; h1 = h0;
		h0 = OffPos() - UBQS_SaberBase.BodyAt(owner);
		if (abs(DeltaAngle(lastYaw, owner.angle)) >= 8.0 || (owner.pos - lastBody).Length() > 48.0) { h1 = h0; h2 = h0; h3 = h0; }
		lastYaw = owner.angle;
		lastBody = owner.pos;

		let off = p.OffhandWeapon;
		bool forceHand = off is "UBQS_ForceHand";
		bool saberUp = (p.ReadyWeapon is "UBQS_SaberBase") || forceHand;
		int bits = 0;
		if (forceHand) bits = BT_OFFHANDATTACK | BT_OFFHANDALTATTACK;
		else if (off is "UBQS_SaberOff" && IV("ubqs_force_gestures", 1) && !UBQS_SaberBase(off).merged) bits = BT_OFFHANDALTATTACK;
		bool held = bits != 0 && (p.cmd.buttons & bits);

		if (gripped) GripTick(held);
		else if (held)
		{
			if (!armed) { armed = true; fired = false; armTics = 0; }
			armTics++;
			if (!fired) Gesture();
		}
		else armed = false;

		SlamTick();
		PulledTick();
		if (saberUp) ForceJump(p);
	}

	// ---- READING THE HAND ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	private void Gesture()
	{
		Vector3 hv = HandVel();
		double sp = hv.Length();
		double thr = FV("ubqs_force_gesture", 2.0);
		Vector3 fwd = ViewFwd();
		if (sp >= thr)
		{
			Vector3 u = hv / sp;
			double dd = u dot fwd;
			if (dd >= 0.55) { Push(OffPos(), (u + fwd).Unit()); fired = true; return; }
			if (dd <= -0.55) { Pull(OffPos(), (OffAim() + fwd).Unit()); fired = true; return; }
		}
		// held still: reach for something to grip (looked for every few tics, not every one)
		if (armTics >= 8 && sp < 1.5 && level.maptime - lastScan >= 3)
		{
			lastScan = level.maptime;
			let t = FindGrip();
			if (t) { StartGrip(t); fired = true; }
		}
	}

	// ---- PUSH ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// Everything in a cone in front of the hand is thrown back -- the lighter it is the farther -- and knocked
	// about; shots in the cone are turned round. A shock ring rolls out along the cone (particles: no light).
	void Push(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d)
	{
		if (!owner) return;
		if (level.maptime < pushReady) { owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/off", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.25); return; }
		pushReady = level.maptime + int(FV("ubqs_push_cooldown", 1.5) * 35);
		double range = FV("ubqs_push_range", 448.0), cone = 40.0;
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/push", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0);
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z - range, range * 2.0, range, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || mo is "UBQS_Thrown" || mo is "UBQS_Light" || mo is "UBQS_Remote") continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(hp, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < 1 || dist > range) continue;
			Vector3 u = to / dist;
			if (acos(clamp(u dot d, -1.0, 1.0)) > cone) continue;
			if (mo.bMissile)
			{
				if (mo.target == owner) continue;
				double sp = max(mo.Speed, mo.vel.Length());
				Actor shooter = mo.target;
				mo.target = owner;
				if (mo.bSeekerMissile) mo.tracer = shooter;
				mo.vel = u * max(sp, 8.0);
				mo.angle = VectorAngle(u.x, u.y);
				mo.pitch = -asin(clamp(u.z, -1.0, 1.0));
				continue;
			}
			if (!mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bDontThrust || (mo.player && !deathmatch) || (mo.bFriendly && owner.player)) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			double falloff = 1.0 - dist / range * 0.6;
			double f = clamp(2400.0 / max(mo.Mass, 50), 2.0, 26.0) * falloff * FV("ubqs_push_power", 1.0);
			mo.vel += (u.x * f, u.y * f, max(u.z * f, 0.0) + f * 0.3);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, owner, int(FV("ubqs_push_damage", 8.0)), 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
		}
		Ring(hp, d, 1.0);
		Buzz();
	}
	// the shock ring: out along the cone (dir 1) or rushing in to the hand (dir -1)
	void Ring(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d, double dir)
	{
		// the CombatFX shockwave ring, pale blue: rolling out (push) or rushing in (pull)
		bool rev = dir < 0;
		UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + d * (rev ? 60.0 : 36.0), 'UXRG', 17, 1, 0.3, 0.85, 0xB8D8FF, rev ? 0.97 : 1.03, rev);
		UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + d * (rev ? 150.0 : 110.0), 'UXRG', 17, 1, 0.6, 0.6, 0xB8D8FF, rev ? 0.97 : 1.03, rev);
	}

	// ---- PULL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void Pull(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d)
	{
		if (level.maptime < pushReady) { owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/off", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.25); return; }
		pushReady = level.maptime + int(FV("ubqs_push_cooldown", 1.5) * 35);
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/pull", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0);
		// your sabers, wherever they are, come home
		for (let item = owner.Inv; item; item = item.Inv)
		{
